text: Let's sink to the bottom of the ocean.
Two hundred metres. Almost all the sunlight is already gone.
Three hundred and thirty-two. The deepest anyone has ever gone on scuba.
One thousand. Total darkness. From here on, the only light is made by animals.
Nearly three thousand. A Cuvier's beaked whale was tracked diving this deep. On one breath.
Three thousand eight hundred. The Titanic.
Four thousand. The abyss. Near freezing, and four hundred times the pressure at the surface.
Eight thousand three hundred and thirty-six. The deepest fish ever filmed. A little snailfish, just swimming.
Almost eleven thousand metres. The Challenger Deep. Fewer people have been here than to space.
And down here, someone already found... a plastic bag.
